{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /root/.claude/skills/pdf\n\n# PDF Processing Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nThis guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see reference.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read forms.md and follow its instructions.\n\n## Quick Start\n\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter\n\n# Read a PDF\nreader = PdfReader(\"document.pdf\")\nprint(f\"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}\")\n\n# Extract text\ntext = \"\"\nfor page in reader.pages:\n    text += page.extract_text()\n```\n\n## Python Libraries\n\n### pypdf - Basic Operations\n\n#### Merge PDFs\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader\n\nwriter = PdfWriter()\nfor pdf_file in [\"doc1.pdf\", \"doc2.pdf\", \"doc3.pdf\"]:\n    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)\n    for page in reader.pages:\n        writer.add_page(page)\n\nwith open(\"merged.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n#### Split PDF\n```python\nreader = PdfReader(\"input.pdf\")\nfor i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):\n    writer = PdfWriter()\n    writer.add_page(page)\n    with open(f\"page_{i+1}.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n        writer.write(output)\n```\n\n#### Extract Metadata\n```python\nreader = PdfReader(\"document.pdf\")\nmeta = reader.metadata\nprint(f\"Title: {meta.title}\")\nprint(f\"Author: {meta.author}\")\nprint(f\"Subject: {meta.subject}\")\nprint(f\"Creator: {meta.creator}\")\n```\n\n#### Rotate Pages\n```python\nreader = PdfReader(\"input.pdf\")\nwriter = PdfWriter()\n\npage = reader.pages[0]\npage.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise\nwriter.add_page(page)\n\nwith open(\"rotated.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction\n\n#### Extract Text with Layout\n```python\nimport pdfplumber\n\nwith pdfplumber.open(\"document.pdf\") as pdf:\n    for page in pdf.pages:\n        text = page.extract_text()\n        print(text)\n```\n\n#### Extract Tables\n```python\nwith pdfplumber.open(\"document.pdf\") as pdf:\n    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):\n        tables = page.extract_tables()\n        for j, table in enumerate(tables):\n            print(f\"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:\")\n            for row in table:\n                print(row)\n```\n\n#### Advanced Table Extraction\n```python\nimport pandas as pd\n\nwith pdfplumber.open(\"document.pdf\") as pdf:\n    all_tables = []\n    for page in pdf.pages:\n        tables = page.extract_tables()\n        for table in tables:\n            if table:  # Check if table is not empty\n                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])\n                all_tables.append(df)\n\n# Combine all tables\nif all_tables:\n    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)\n    combined_df.to_excel(\"extracted_tables.xlsx\", index=False)\n```\n\n### reportlab - Create PDFs\n\n#### Basic PDF Creation\n```python\nfrom reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter\nfrom reportlab.pdfgen import canvas\n\nc = canvas.Canvas(\"hello.pdf\", pagesize=letter)\nwidth, height = letter\n\n# Add text\nc.drawString(100, height - 100, \"Hello World!\")\nc.drawString(100, height - 120, \"This is a PDF created with reportlab\")\n\n# Add a line\nc.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)\n\n# Save\nc.save()\n```\n\n#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages\n```python\nfrom reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter\nfrom reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak\nfrom reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet\n\ndoc = SimpleDocTemplate(\"report.pdf\", pagesize=letter)\nstyles = getSampleStyleSheet()\nstory = []\n\n# Add content\ntitle = Paragraph(\"Report Title\", styles['Title'])\nstory.append(title)\nstory.append(Spacer(1, 12))\n\nbody = Paragraph(\"This is the body of the report. \" * 20, styles['Normal'])\nstory.append(body)\nstory.append(PageBreak())\n\n# Page 2\nstory.append(Paragraph(\"Page 2\", styles['Heading1']))\nstory.append(Paragraph(\"Content for page 2\", styles['Normal']))\n\n# Build PDF\ndoc.build(story)\n```\n\n## Command-Line Tools\n\n### pdftotext (poppler-utils)\n```bash\n# Extract text\npdftotext input.pdf output.txt\n\n# Extract text preserving layout\npdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt\n\n# Extract specific pages\npdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5\n```\n\n### qpdf\n```bash\n# Merge PDFs\nqpdf --empty --pages file1.pdf file2.pdf -- merged.pdf\n\n# Split pages\nqpdf input.pdf --pages . 1-5 -- pages1-5.pdf\nqpdf input.pdf --pages . 6-10 -- pages6-10.pdf\n\n# Rotate pages\nqpdf input.pdf output.pdf --rotate=+90:1  # Rotate page 1 by 90 degrees\n\n# Remove password\nqpdf --password=mypassword --decrypt encrypted.pdf decrypted.pdf\n```\n\n### pdftk (if available)\n```bash\n# Merge\npdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf\n\n# Split\npdftk input.pdf burst\n\n# Rotate\npdftk input.pdf rotate 1east output rotated.pdf\n```\n\n## Common Tasks\n\n### Extract Text from Scanned PDFs\n```python\n# Requires: pip install pytesseract pdf2image\nimport pytesseract\nfrom pdf2image import convert_from_path\n\n# Convert PDF to images\nimages = convert_from_path('scanned.pdf')\n\n# OCR each page\ntext = \"\"\nfor i, image in enumerate(images):\n    text += f\"Page {i+1}:\\n\"\n    text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)\n    text += \"\\n\\n\"\n\nprint(text)\n```\n\n### Add Watermark\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter\n\n# Create watermark (or load existing)\nwatermark = PdfReader(\"watermark.pdf\").pages[0]\n\n# Apply to all pages\nreader = PdfReader(\"document.pdf\")\nwriter = PdfWriter()\n\nfor page in reader.pages:\n    page.merge_page(watermark)\n    writer.add_page(page)\n\nwith open(\"watermarked.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n### Extract Images\n```bash\n# Using pdfimages (poppler-utils)\npdfimages -j input.pdf output_prefix\n\n# This extracts all images as output_prefix-000.jpg, output_prefix-001.jpg, etc.\n```\n\n### Password Protection\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter\n\nreader = PdfReader(\"input.pdf\")\nwriter = PdfWriter()\n\nfor page in reader.pages:\n    writer.add_page(page)\n\n# Add password\nwriter.encrypt(\"userpassword\", \"ownerpassword\")\n\nwith open(\"encrypted.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n## Quick Reference\n\n| Task | Best Tool | Command/Code |\n|------|-----------|--------------|\n| Merge PDFs | pypdf | `writer.add_page(page)` |\n| Split PDFs | pypdf | One page per file |\n| Extract text | pdfplumber | `page.extract_text()` |\n| Extract tables | pdfplumber | `page.extract_tables()` |\n| Create PDFs | reportlab | Canvas or Platypus |\n| Command line merge | qpdf | `qpdf --empty --pages ...` |\n| OCR scanned PDFs | pytesseract | Convert to image first |\n| Fill PDF forms | pdf-lib or pypdf (see forms.md) | See forms.md |\n\n## Next Steps\n\n- For advanced pypdfium2 usage, see reference.md\n- For JavaScript libraries (pdf-lib), see reference.md\n- If you need to fill out a PDF form, follow the instructions in forms.md\n- For troubleshooting guides, see reference.md\n\n\nARGUMENTS: /root/calendar.pdf"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d7cb20c0-b936-44c5-8cbf-14f3bfa30a2f","uuid":"7d1d6058-b93a-4d82-80a7-60293c0c0344","timestamp":"2026-03-23T21:58:01.377Z","isSynthetic":true}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01ScZW8fMjh6RQsZpPkHfkdS","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015UNUp39xTz8xNDrWdHnYPp","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/root/analyze_calendar.py","content":"import pdfplumber\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Helper: convert a y-coordinate (PDF \"top\" value) to a wall-clock time\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# From the extracted data:\n#   12am label  top ≈ 39.2   → corresponds to grid line top ≈ 43.9\n#    1am label  top ≈ 69.1   → grid line  top ≈ 73.9\n# Each hour = 30 px  → each 15-min slot = 7.5 px\n# The grid starts at top=43.9 for 12:00 am (midnight)\n\nGRID_TOP   = 43.9    # y-position of the 12:00 am (midnight) grid line\nPX_PER_MIN = 30 / 60  # 30 px per hour → 0.5 px per minute\n\ndef y_to_time(y):\n    \"\"\"Convert a PDF y-coordinate to a HH:MM string (24-h).\"\"\"\n    minutes_from_midnight = (y - GRID_TOP) / PX_PER_MIN\n    total_minutes = round(minutes_from_midnight)\n    h = total_minutes // 60\n    m = total_minutes % 60\n    return f\"{h:02d}:{m:02d}\"\n\ndef fmt_time(hhmm_24):\n    \"\"\"Format 24-h HH:MM as 12-h h:MM am/pm.\"\"\"\n    h, m = map(int, hhmm_24.split(\":\"))\n    period = \"am\" if h < 12 else \"pm\"\n    h12 = h % 12 or 12\n    return f\"{h12}:{m:02d} {period}\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Colour identification\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef classify_color(rgb):\n    \"\"\"Return a human-readable colour name for a fill tuple.\"\"\"\n    if rgb is None:\n        return \"none\"\n    if isinstance(rgb, (int, float)):\n        # greyscale\n        v = rgb\n        if v > 0.9:\n            return \"white\"\n        if v < 0.2:\n            return \"black\"\n        return f\"grey({v:.2f})\"\n\n    r, g, b = rgb\n    # Dark grey / charcoal  ≈ (0.38, 0.38, 0.38)\n    if abs(r - g) < 0.05 and abs(g - b) < 0.05 and r < 0.5:\n        return \"dark-grey\"\n    # Light blue background ≈ (0.91, 0.93, 0.97)\n    if r > 0.85 and b > r and b > g:\n        return \"light-blue-bg\"\n    # Salmon / coral red ≈ (0.90, 0.49, 0.45)\n    if r > 0.7 and g < 0.6 and b < 0.6 and r > g:\n        return \"salmon-red\"\n    # Blue-purple ≈ (0.47, 0.53, 0.80)\n    if b > 0.6 and b > r and b > g:\n        return \"blue\"\n    # Yellow-green ≈ (0.75, 0.79, 0.20)\n    if g > 0.5 and r > 0.5 and b < 0.4:\n        return \"yellow-green\"\n    return f\"rgb({r:.2f},{g:.2f},{b:.2f})\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Main analysis\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------\nwith pdfplumber.open(\"/root/calendar.pdf\") as pdf:\n    page = pdf.pages[0]\n\n    words  = page.extract_words()\n    lines  = page.lines\n    curves = page.curves\n\n    # --- 1. Time labels on the left axis ---\n    time_labels = sorted(\n        [w for w in words if w['x0'] < 65],\n        key=lambda w: w['top']\n    )\n    # Remove the header label \"GenSkillBench\"\n    time_labels = [w for w in time_labels if ':' not in w['text'] and\n                   w['text'] not in ('GenSkillBench',)]\n\n    print(\"=\" * 68)\n    print(\"CALENDAR: Mon Mar 9, 2026 (Eastern Time - New York)\")\n    print(\"=\" * 68)\n\n    print(\"\\n--- TIME AXIS LABELS (left column) ---\")\n    for w in time_labels:\n        print(f\"  {w['text']:6s}  top={w['top']:.1f}  → grid y≈{w['top']+4.7:.1f}\")\n\n    # --- 2. Horizontal grid lines (all ~7.5 px apart = 15 min each) ---\n    horiz = sorted(\n        [l for l in lines if abs(l['top'] - l['bottom']) < 2\n                           and (l['x1'] - l['x0']) > 50],\n        key=lambda l: l['top']\n    )\n    if len(horiz) >= 2:\n        gaps = [horiz[i+1]['top'] - horiz[i]['top'] for i in range(min(5, len(horiz)-1))]\n        avg_gap = sum(gaps) / len(gaps)\n        print(f\"\\nGrid: {len(horiz)} horizontal lines, avg gap = {avg_gap:.2f} px = 15 min\")\n        print(f\"  First line top={horiz[0]['top']:.1f}, last={horiz[-1]['top']:.1f}\")\n\n    # --- 3. Appointment blocks (curves with coloured fill) ---\n    # pdfplumber puts filled rectangles drawn with 'c' operators as curves\n    # Filter out decorative elements: we want tall blocks (height > 5 px)\n    # and exclude the thin yellow-green strips which are colour-key markers\n\n    appointments = []\n    for c in curves:\n        fill  = c.get('non_stroking_color') or c.get('stroking_color')\n        color = classify_color(fill)\n        w     = c['x1'] - c['x0']\n        h     = c['bottom'] - c['top']\n\n        # Skip tiny markers, the left-strip background, and the vertical line\n        if w < 5 or h < 5:\n            continue\n        # Skip the background blue strip on far left (x0 ≈ 25, narrow)\n        if c['x0'] < 30 and w < 50:\n            continue\n        # Skip yellow-green small squares (colour-key markers x0≈72, w≈12)\n        if color == 'yellow-green' and w < 20:\n            continue\n\n        start_time = y_to_time(c['top'])\n        end_time   = y_to_time(c['bottom'])\n\n        # Find text labels whose vertical midpoint falls inside this block\n        block_mid_y_min = c['top']\n        block_mid_y_max = c['bottom']\n        label_words = [\n            ww for ww in words\n            if ww['top'] >= block_mid_y_min - 5\n            and ww['bottom'] <= block_mid_y_max + 5\n            and ww['x0'] > 65\n        ]\n        label = ' '.join(ww['text'] for ww in sorted(label_words, key=lambda x: (x['top'], x['x0'])))\n\n        appointments.append({\n            'label':      label or '(no text)',\n            'top':        c['top'],\n            'bottom':     c['bottom'],\n            'start_24':   start_time,\n            'end_24':     end_time,\n            'start_fmt':  fmt_time(start_time),\n            'end_fmt':    fmt_time(end_time),\n            'color':      color,\n            'fill_raw':   fill,\n            'is_blue':    color == 'blue',\n        })\n\n    print(f\"\\n--- APPOINTMENT BLOCKS ({len(appointments)} found) ---\\n\")\n    for i, appt in enumerate(sorted(appointments, key=lambda a: a['top']), 1):\n        blue_tag = \"  [BLUE / flexible]\" if appt['is_blue'] else \"\"\n        print(f\"  [{i}] {appt['start_fmt']:10s} – {appt['end_fmt']:10s}  \"\n              f\"color={appt['color']:20s}  \\\"{appt['label']}\\\"{blue_tag}\")\n        print(f\"       raw fill={appt['fill_raw']}  \"\n              f\"top={appt['top']:.1f}, bottom={appt['bottom']:.1f}\")\n        print()\n\n    # --- 4. Summary table ---\n    print(\"=\" * 68)\n    print(\"SUMMARY TABLE\")\n    print(\"=\" * 68)\n    print(f\"{'#':<3} {'Start':>10} {'End':>10}  {'Color':<22} {'Label'}\")\n    print(\"-\" * 68)\n    for i, appt in enumerate(sorted(appointments, key=lambda a: a['top']), 1):\n        blue_note = \" (blue=flexible)\" if appt['is_blue'] else \"\"\n        print(f\"{i:<3} {appt['start_fmt']:>10} {appt['end_fmt']:>10}  \"\n              f\"{appt['color'] + blue_note:<38} {appt['label']}\")\n\n    # --- 5. Colour legend ---\n    print(\"\\n--- COLOUR LEGEND ---\")\n    seen = {}\n    for appt in sorted(appointments, key=lambda a: a['top']):\n        c = appt['color']\n        if c not in seen:\n            seen[c] = appt['fill_raw']\n    for color_name, raw in seen.items():\n        print(f\"  {color_name:25s} raw={raw}\")\n    print()\n    print(\"NOTE: 'blue' blocks = low-priority / flexible appointments.\")\n    print(\"      'salmon-red' blocks = busy/fixed appointments.\")\n    print(\"      'dark-grey' blocks = out-of-office / unavailable spans.\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":12648,"cache_read_input_tokens":9857,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":12648,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01UqUDfeh579N7cBDCRyQstx","session_id":"d7cb20c0-b936-44c5-8cbf-14f3bfa30a2f","uuid":"286c90a7-0722-45d0-b6d4-f19b1e57741b"}
